questionText:
Arrange the following water-related policy landmarks in India in chronological sequence:

(A) Launch of Namami Gange Programme
(B) Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act
(C) Launch of Ganga Action Plan Phase I
(D) Adoption of first National Water Policy

Choose the correct sequence from the options given below:
